UnitStatement: lens-register is the normal ORCHESTRATOR Phase 2.4 setup-pipeline skill for PROJECT and SOFTWARE semantic lensing.
lens-register is dispatched through TASK as a bounded method pack.
lens-register reads one deliverable folder, parses _SEMANTIC.md, scans production documents, and writes _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
Normal ORCHESTRATOR dispatch uses the TASK generic shell for lens-register.
A lens-register brief must authorize _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md writes.
ScopePath must be the absolute path to one production unit folder and is the TASK-normalized scope root.
TaskSkill must be lens-register.
RuntimeOverrides.deliverable_folder must equal ScopePath and serves as the skill explicit scope anchor.
_SEMANTIC.md must exist in the deliverable folder.
If _SEMANTIC.md is absent, lens-register writes a blocking _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md header and stops.
RuntimeOverrides.DECOMP_VARIANT may be PROJECT or SOFTWARE and defaults to PROJECT.
RuntimeOverrides.STATUS_POLICY is NO_STATUS_TOUCH for normal Phase 2.4.
AllowedWriteTargets should include only {deliverable_folder}/_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md and {deliverable_folder}/_run_records/.
deliverable_folder may be supplied as a top-level legacy field, but RuntimeOverrides.deliverable_folder is preferred.
DeliverablePath is only a compatibility alias and does not affect TASK write authorization.
A top-level DECOMP_VARIANT is overridden by RuntimeOverrides.DECOMP_VARIANT.
DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN is unsupported because DOMAIN pipelines skip semantic lensing.
When DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN is passed, lens-register refuses gracefully and does not write _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
lens-register does not accept multi-deliverable scope.
lens-register does not accept cross-deliverable scanning.
lens-register does not follow external references from _REFERENCES.md unless a separate authorized task provides those sources in scope.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief tells lens-register to load its SKILL.md and companion files.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief tells lens-register to read _SEMANTIC.md and production documents for the deliverable.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief tells lens-register to parse only primary Result tables for matrices A, B, C, F, D, X, and E.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief tells lens-register to generate or overwrite _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief treats _SEMANTIC.md as a lens source, not an authority.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief instructs lens-register to ignore Matrix Summary, Matrix Z, derivation tables, and structural matrices K, G, T.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief requires production documents, _SEMANTIC.md, and _STATUS.md to remain read-only.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief records only warranted items with SourcePath and SectionRef.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief requires lens-specific NO_ITEMS notes instead of repeated boilerplate.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief prohibits following external references outside the deliverable folder.
The canonical Phase 2.4 brief prohibits claiming validate_lens_register.py PASS unless the validator actually ran.
_SEMANTIC.md is the source of lens matrices A, B, C, F, D, X, and E.
_CONTEXT.md supplies deliverable identity when present.
_STATUS.md is read-only lifecycle state when present.
Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md are the standard production document set.
Missing standard production documents produce WARNING MISSING_DOC rather than failure.
_REFERENCES.md is deliverable-local metadata only; lens-register lists pointers but does not expand them.
_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md is overwritten each run at {deliverable_folder}/_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
{deliverable_folder}/_run_records/TASK_RUN_*.md is a TASK shell run record, not a skill-authored output.
A valid run requires ScopePath to exist and be a readable directory.
A valid run requires deliverable_folder to resolve to the same directory as ScopePath.
A valid run requires _SEMANTIC.md to be present or the run must output a blocking header and stop.
A valid run accepts DECOMP_VARIANT PROJECT, SOFTWARE, or absent default PROJECT, and refuses DOMAIN.
A valid run writes _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md unless refused before output or failed during input validation.
A valid run modifies no production documents.
A valid run does not modify _SEMANTIC.md.
A valid run does not modify _STATUS.md under STATUS_POLICY=NO_STATUS_TOUCH.
A valid run reads or writes no files outside {deliverable_folder}/ except TASK run records under {deliverable_folder}/_run_records/.
If validate_lens_register.py is available and permitted, it must pass before the run reports validator PASS.
If the validator is unavailable or not permitted, the run reports Validator: NOT_RUN and does not claim validator PASS.
Every cell of each lensed matrix A, B, C, F, D, X, and E must have a Lens Coverage entry.
K, G, and T are excluded from lensing because they are transposes or truncations that duplicate D or B coverage.
Lenses are parsed from primary Result tables only, not derivation tables, Matrix Summary, Matrix Z, or compact summary duplicates.
Warranted items must be grounded in production-document evidence or explicit absence.
Every warranted item must have SourcePath plus SectionRef or accepted absence wording.
Conflict items must have at least two contenders and HumanRuling=TBD.
Summary counts must match the actual warranted items in the file.
The output must use the exact STRUCTURE schema and required column order.
The run must process exactly one deliverable folder and perform no cross-deliverable scanning.
Production documents, _SEMANTIC.md, and _STATUS.md are protected read-only files.
NO_ITEMS rows must explain the specific lens/document-role outcome; repeated boilerplate is invalid.
A run failing any required invariant is invalid unless failure behavior explicitly defines a blocking or refusal output.
The skill must process matrices A, B, C, F, D, X, and E from _SEMANTIC.md.
The skill must ignore structural matrices K, G, and T when parsing _SEMANTIC.md.
The skill must ignore Matrix Z - Summary Boundary when present.
The skill must ignore Matrix Summary and compact summary tables or lists.
The skill must ignore derivation-work tables and intermediate collections.
The skill must use the first complete ### Result table inside each required matrix section as the authoritative lens table.
If a matrix Result table is missing, malformed, or has empty cells, lens-register creates MATRIX_ERROR coverage rows and Type=MatrixError items referencing _SEMANTIC.md.
The output file header must include Generated, Deliverable Folder, DECOMP_VARIANT, StatusPolicy, Validator, Inputs Read, Purpose, and Warnings when applicable.
The output summary block must appear before matrix sections and use integer counts, including zero when applicable.
The output must include one matrix section per matrix in fixed order A, B, C, F, D, X, E.
Each matrix section contains a Lens Coverage table with one row per matrix cell in row-major order.
A Warranted Items table appears only when at least one item exists for that matrix.
Lens Coverage columns are LensKey, RowLabel, ColLabel, LensValue, ItemCount, CoverageStatus, and Notes.
Warranted Items columns are ItemID, LensKey, Type, AppliesToDoc, SuggestedEditDoc, CandidateInfo, WhyWarranted, SourcePath, SectionRef, Contenders, ProposedAuthority (PROPOSAL), and HumanRuling.
CoverageStatus values are NO_ITEMS, HAS_ITEMS, and MATRIX_ERROR.
Warranted item Type values are MissingSlot, WeakStatement, Conflict, VerificationGap, RationaleGap, Normalization, TBD_Question, and MatrixError.
Every NO_ITEMS row must contain a lens-specific note.
Invalid NO_ITEMS boilerplate includes No warranted items found, No issues, and N/A.
Valid NO_ITEMS notes describe a specific alignment, coverage, rationale, or absence outcome for the lens.
Every warranted item must cite production-document evidence or explicitly record absence.
Speculative or unsupported content must become Type=TBD_Question.
The skill must not introduce new numeric values, new normative requirements, or acceptance claims.
The skill must not claim compliance with a standard whose text is not present.
_SEMANTIC.md and _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md are not evidence sources for engineering facts.
Conflicts are surfaced, not resolved.
HumanRuling is always TBD unless a pre-existing human ruling is citable.
ProposedAuthority is always PROPOSAL and never authoritative.
When DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN is passed, lens-register writes no _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md and modifies no file.
The DOMAIN refusal message is: DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN is not supported by lens-register; DOMAIN pipelines skip the semantic lensing step.
If _SEMANTIC.md is missing, lens-register writes _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md with a blocking header and reports RUN_STATUS=BLOCKED.
If {deliverable_folder} does not exist or is not readable, lens-register reports RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS and does not write.
If a production document is missing, lens-register records WARNING MISSING_DOC in the output header and continues.
If a matrix cell is empty or malformed, lens-register sets CoverageStatus=MATRIX_ERROR, adds a Type=MatrixError item, and continues.
If validator is unavailable, lens-register reports Validator: NOT_RUN and does not call the run validator-passed.
If validator fails, lens-register reports RUN_STATUS=FAILED with validator errors.
A clean run reports RUN_STATUS=OK.
A clean run reports deliverable ID/name.
A clean run reports that _SEMANTIC.md was present and parsed from primary Result tables.
A clean run reports warranted-item counts by total, document, matrix, and type.
A clean run reports matrix parsing errors, missing documents, and conflicts when present.
A clean run reports the path to _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
A clean run reports Validator: PASS or Validator: NOT_RUN with a reason.
A clean run reports _STATUS.md unchanged and no production documents modified.
Conflict items require at least two path#section entries in Contenders and HumanRuling=TBD.
VerificationGap items require citation of the normative requirement whose acceptance is missing or ambiguous.
MissingSlot items require documents searched in SourcePath and either a section or entire document scanned in SectionRef.
WeakStatement items require a document and section citation for ambiguous language.
RationaleGap items require a document and section citation for the decision or requirement lacking rationale.
Normalization items require two or more locations where terminology diverges.
TBD_Question items require rationale and who or what to consult in CandidateInfo.
MatrixError items require reference to the affected cell in _SEMANTIC.md.
lens-register generates a matrix-organized, coverage-complete semantic lensing register from _SEMANTIC.md and production documents.
lens-register is a setup-pipeline companion to the interactive semantic-lensing skill.
lens-register is compatible with Chirality TASK and dispatched by ORCHESTRATOR setup pipeline Phase 2.4.
_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md uses each primary Result-table cell of matrices A, B, C, F, D, X, E from _SEMANTIC.md as a lens.
_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md applies each lens to deliverable-local production documents.
_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md records only warranted enrichment inputs with provenance and does not rewrite documents.
semantic-lensing is the interactive counterpart that produces human-facing proposals or reviews existing register entries.
four-documents Pass 3 consumes the register created by lens-register.
lens-register runs in TASK generic shell with no profile.
The typical dispatcher passes TaskSkill:lens-register, ScopePath, RuntimeOverrides.deliverable_folder, and write authorization for _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
Required input ScopePath is the absolute path to one production unit folder.
Required input deliverable_folder is the absolute path to the same folder, normally supplied in RuntimeOverrides.
Required input _SEMANTIC.md resides in the deliverable folder.
DECOMP_VARIANT optional values are PROJECT or SOFTWARE with PROJECT default; DOMAIN is not supported.
STATUS_POLICY defaults to NO_STATUS_TOUCH.
DeliverablePath is a compatibility alias only and does not affect TASK write authorization.
_SEMANTIC.md is required and supplies lenses.
Contextual inputs, when present, are _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, Procedure.md, and _REFERENCES.md.
_REFERENCES.md is metadata only and external paths from it are not followed.
Missing production documents produce warnings, not failure.
deliverable_folder runtime override is required and must be an absolute path equal to ScopePath.
DECOMP_VARIANT runtime override defaults to PROJECT and allows PROJECT or SOFTWARE.
STATUS_POLICY runtime override defaults to and allows NO_STATUS_TOUCH.
DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN is refused because DOMAIN pipelines skip semantic lensing.
lens-register generation is reasoning-first.
Deterministic validation is optional but expected when the validator exists and the brief permits it.
No deterministic tool is required to generate _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md.
Optional validators after generation include validate_lens_register.py and validate_semantic_pipeline_scope.py --step lens.
The allowed-tools frontmatter field is intentionally omitted; TASK may still enforce a brief-provided allowlist.
_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md is the skill-authored output and is overwritten each run.
_run_records/TASK_RUN_*.md is TASK shell output.
lens-register operates on exactly one folder per run.
Production documents Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md must not be edited.
_SEMANTIC.md is a lens source, not an output target or engineering authority.
_STATUS.md is read-only under normal Phase 2.4 NO_STATUS_TOUCH policy.
lens-register must not follow _REFERENCES.md paths or read outside the deliverable folder.
Matrix cells shape what to look for and do not justify inventing content.
Unknowns become TBD_Question; gaps become MissingSlot; conflicts become Conflict.
Every warranted item requires SourcePath and SectionRef or explicit absence provenance.
Conflicts are surfaced, not resolved; HumanRuling remains TBD unless a prior human ruling is cited.
Every cell in A, B, C, F, D, X, and E must appear in Lens Coverage.
K and T are transposes and G is a truncation; they are not lensed because they duplicate D/B coverage.
Parser hygiene requires ignoring derivation tables, Matrix Summary, and Matrix Z and parsing only primary Result tables.
NO_ITEMS notes must be lens-specific and not boilerplate.
PROTOCOL governs sequencing and run behavior.
SPEC governs validity.
STRUCTURE defines output schema.
RATIONALE governs interpretation when ambiguity remains.
Instruction conflicts must be flagged and returned to the invoker.
A Lens is a matrix Result-table cell used as a question-shaping perspective.
A LensKey is a canonical identifier formatted M:[RowLabel]:[ColLabel].
A Warranted item is a grounded gap, conflict, weak statement, normalization risk, rationale gap, verification gap, or TBD question.
Production documents are Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md.
Structural matrices are K, G, and T and are excluded because they duplicate predecessor content.
Step 0 resolves ScopePath and deliverable_folder and requires them to identify the same readable directory.
Step 0 refuses DECOMP_VARIANT=DOMAIN gracefully without writing files.
Step 0 confirms _SEMANTIC.md exists and writes a blocking _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md header if it is missing.
Step 0 confirms production documents exist; missing production documents produce WARNING MISSING_DOC and the run proceeds.
Step 0 confirms no write target outside _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md and TASK _run_records/ is required.
Step 1 reads _CONTEXT.md if present.
Step 1 reads _STATUS.md if present, records state, and does not change it.
Step 1 reads _SEMANTIC.md.
Step 1 reads existing production documents.
Step 1 reads _REFERENCES.md if present as metadata only and does not follow external paths.
Step 2 locates each matrix section for matrices A, B, C, F, D, X, and E.
Step 2 locates the first primary ### Result table in each matrix section.
Step 2 extracts row labels, column labels, and cell values from the primary Result table.
Step 2 creates one Lens Coverage row per cell in row-major order.
A Lens Coverage row sets LensKey to M:[RowLabel]:[ColLabel].
A Lens Coverage row sets LensValue to the cell value.
A Lens Coverage row starts with ItemCount=0.
A Lens Coverage row starts with CoverageStatus=NO_ITEMS.
A Lens Coverage row starts with a lens-specific Notes value.
Step 2 ignores derivation/intermediate work tables, Matrix Summary, Matrix Z, and structural matrices K, G, T.
If a required matrix or cell is malformed, lens-register records MATRIX_ERROR and continues.
Step 3 scans production documents for each LensKey.
Step 3 asks what gap, conflict, ambiguity, missing verification, missing rationale, or terminology risk becomes salient under each lens.
Step 3 records an item only when it meets the warranted threshold.
Step 3 updates ItemCount, CoverageStatus, and Notes.
Warranted item types are Conflict, VerificationGap, MissingSlot, WeakStatement, RationaleGap, Normalization, TBD_Question, and MatrixError.
The tight filter forbids recording restatements.
The tight filter forbids padding the register for coverage.
The tight filter forbids creating items merely because a lens exists.
When documents are already clear and aligned under a lens, lens-register records NO_ITEMS with a specific note.
Step 4 writes or overwrites _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md using the STRUCTURE schema.
Step 5 confirms protected files were not modified.
Step 5 confirms coverage completeness and schema compliance.
Step 5 runs validate_lens_register.py if available and permitted.
Step 5 reports validator status as PASS, FAILED, or NOT_RUN.
Step 5 returns the run report to TASK/ORCHESTRATOR.
Zero-item cells are valid when their notes are lens-specific.
Use TBD_Question when required information is absent or external.
Every warranted item includes SourcePath and SectionRef, and includes Contenders when conflict exists.
The skill must not choose a winner, introduce requirements, or assert compliance.
Human rulings remain TBD unless already citable.
Output must use stable ordering and exact table schemas.
The run must not read sibling deliverables or external references; _REFERENCES.md is metadata only.
_STATUS.md is not changed by lens-register.
The file header schema includes Generated, DECOMP_VARIANT, Deliverable Folder, StatusPolicy, Validator, Warnings, Inputs Read, and Purpose fields.
The Summary block reports total warranted items, counts by document, counts by matrix, counts by type, notable conflicts, and matrix parse errors.
Matrix sections are emitted for A, B, C, F, D, X, and E in order.
Lens Coverage table rows use LensKey, RowLabel, ColLabel, LensValue, ItemCount, CoverageStatus, and Notes columns.

Warranted Items table rows use ItemID, LensKey, Type, AppliesToDoc, SuggestedEditDoc, CandidateInfo, WhyWarranted, SourcePath, SectionRef, Contenders, ProposedAuthority (PROPOSAL), and HumanRuling columns.
Omit Warranted Items for a matrix only when no warranted items exist for that matrix.
LensKey has the form M:[RowLabel]:[ColLabel].
ItemCount is the integer count of warranted items for the lens.
CoverageStatus is NO_ITEMS, HAS_ITEMS, or MATRIX_ERROR.
Warranted item ItemID is unique within the file and recommended as {Matrix}-{000}.
AppliesToDoc values are Datasheet, Specification, Guidance, Procedure, Multi, and NA.
SuggestedEditDoc is the best-fit later enrichment target, or TBD or NA.
CandidateInfo is short enrichment-ready phrasing rather than full prose.
WhyWarranted is a one- to two-sentence rationale.
SourcePath contains searched or cited file paths.
SectionRef contains a heading anchor, location TBD, or entire document scanned.
Contenders contains two or more path#section entries for conflicts and is blank otherwise.
ProposedAuthority (PROPOSAL) is always PROPOSAL for proposed authority placement.
HumanRuling is TBD unless a prior human ruling is cited.
SuggestedEditDoc maps VerificationGap to Specification and/or Procedure.
SuggestedEditDoc maps RationaleGap to Guidance.
SuggestedEditDoc maps Normalization to Guidance plus affected documents as needed.
SuggestedEditDoc maps WeakStatement to the same document unless role placement suggests otherwise.
SuggestedEditDoc maps MissingSlot to the best-fit document role or TBD.
SuggestedEditDoc maps Conflict, TBD_Question, and MatrixError to NA or TBD.
SourceRefs use file path plus best-effort heading anchors or location TBD.
SourceRefs record traceability and do not make matrices authoritative.
